letter_deductions.deduction: Claim not admissible: Our investigation found charges for services that were not provided: 9 room days and 4 ICU days for a 3-night stay, ventilator support and an MRI that the diagnosis does not support, and services dated after discharge. Under the fraud condition of the policy, the claim is repudiated.
letter_deductions.why: Matches the policy: the claim is not genuine.
